title.en: Unit 11: The Seeker of Truth, Praise and Blame, and the Neighbours' Judge
title.ur: Unit 11: Haqeeqat ki Talash, Madh o Zamm aur Padosiyon ka Qazi

title.en: Intensive reading: The seeker of truth
title.ur: Gehri qirat: Haqeeqat ki talash karne wala

intro.en: In this lesson we read how Salman al-Farisi searched for the truth until he met the Prophet ﷺ and accepted Islam. Read slowly, sentence by sentence, and notice the places he travelled to.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum parhenge ke Salman al-Farisi (radiyallahu anhu) ne haqeeqat ki talash kaise ki, yahan tak ke woh Nabi ﷺ se mile aur Islam qubool kiya. Aahista aahista, jumla ba jumla parhein aur un shehron par dhyan dein jahan woh gaye.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ في هذا الدَّرْسِ كَيْفَ بَحَثَ سَلْمانُ الفارِسِيُّ عَنِ الحَقيقَةِ حَتّى لَقِيَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَأَسْلَمَ. اقْرَأْ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً وَانْتَبِهْ إِلى الأَماكِنِ الَّتي سافَرَ إِلَيْها.

dialogue.ar: تَحَدَّثَ سَلْمانُ الفارِسِيُّ عَنْ قِصَّةِ بَحْثِهِ عَنِ الحَقيقَةِ وَإِسْلامِهِ، فَقالَ:
dialogue.tr: taḥaddatha Salmānu l-Fārisiyyu ʿan qiṣṣati baḥthihi ʿani l-ḥaqīqati wa islāmih, fa-qāl
dialogue.en: Salman al-Farisi told the story of his search for the truth and his Islam, and said:
dialogue.ur: Salman al-Farisi ne haqeeqat ki talash aur apne Islam ki kahani sunayi aur kaha:

dialogue.ar: كُنْتُ مَجوسِيّاً مِنْ أَهْلِ أَصْبَهانَ، وَكُنْتُ قاطِناً عِنْدَ النّارِ الَّتي نوقِدُها.
dialogue.tr: kuntu majūsiyyan min ahli Aṣbahān, wa kuntu qāṭinan ʿinda n-nāri llatī nūqiduhā
dialogue.en: I was a Magian (fire-worshipper) from the people of Isfahan, and I lived beside the fire we kept burning.
dialogue.ur: Main Isfahan ka ek majoosi (aag ko poojne wala) tha aur us aag ke paas rehta tha jo hum jalaye rakhte the.

dialogue.ar: فَسَأَلْتُ النَّصارى حينَ أَعْجَبَنِي أَمْرُهُمْ وَصَلاتُهُمْ عَنْ أَصْلِ دينِهِمْ، فَقالوا: في الشّامِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-saʾaltu n-naṣārā ḥīna aʿjabanī amruhum wa ṣalātuhum ʿan aṣli dīnihim, fa-qālū: fi sh-Shām
dialogue.en: I asked the Christians, when their way and prayer pleased me, about the origin of their religion, and they said: in Syria.
dialogue.ur: Jab mujhe un ka tareeqa aur namaz pasand aayi to maine Isayiyon se un ke deen ki asl ke bare mein poocha. Unhon ne kaha: Shaam mein.

dialogue.ar: فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلى الشّامِ، وَأَقَمْتُ مَعَ الأُسْقُفِّ صاحِبِ الكَنيسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-nṭalaqtu ilā sh-Shām, wa aqamtu maʿa l-usquffi ṣāḥibi l-kanīsa
dialogue.en: So I set off to Syria and stayed with the bishop, the owner of the church.
dialogue.ur: Phir main Shaam gaya aur girjaghar ke malik bishop ke saath theher gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ هَذا الأُسْقُفُّ رَجُلَ سوءٍ في دينِهِ، ثُمَّ ماتَ، وَجاءوا بِآخَرَ خَيْرٍ مِنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna hādha l-usquffu rajula sūʾin fī dīnih, thumma māt, wa jāʾū bi-ākhara khayrin minh
dialogue.en: This bishop was a bad man in his religion. Then he died, and they brought another, better than him.
dialogue.ur: Yeh bishop apne deen mein bura aadmi tha. Phir woh mar gaya aur log us se behtar doosra le aaye.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا حَضَرَتْهُ الوَفاةُ، قُلْتُ لَهُ: إِلى مَنْ تُوصي بي؟
dialogue.tr: fa-lammā ḥaḍarathu l-wafāh, qultu lah: ilā man tūṣī bī?
dialogue.en: When death came to him, I said to him: To whom do you advise me to go?
dialogue.ur: Jab us ki maut ka waqt aaya to maine kaha: Aap mujhe kis ke paas jaane ki wasiyat karte hain?

dialogue.ar: قالَ: أَيْ بُنَيَّ، ما أَعْرِفُ أَحَداً مِنَ النّاسِ عَلى مِثْلِ ما أَنا عَلَيْهِ، إِلاّ رَجُلاً بِالمَوْصِلِ.
dialogue.tr: qāl: ay bunayya, mā aʿrifu aḥadan mina n-nāsi ʿalā mithli mā anā ʿalayh, illā rajulan bi-l-Mawṣil
dialogue.en: He said: My son, I know no one on the same way as I am, except a man in Mosul.
dialogue.ur: Us ne kaha: Beta, main kisi ko nahin jaanta jo meri tarah ke raaste par ho, siwaye Mosul ke ek aadmi ke.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا تُوُفِّيَ أَتَيْتُ صاحِبَ المَوْصِلِ وَأَقَمْتُ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ حَضَرَتْهُ الوَفاةُ، فَدَلَّني عَلى عابِدٍ في نَصيبينَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-lammā tuwuffiya ataytu ṣāḥiba l-Mawṣil wa aqamtu maʿah, thumma ḥaḍarathu l-wafāh, fa-dallanī ʿalā ʿābidin fī Naṣībīn
dialogue.en: When he died, I went to the man of Mosul and stayed with him. Then death came to him too, and he pointed me to a worshipper in Nasibin.
dialogue.ur: Jab woh faut hua to main Mosul wale ke paas aaya aur us ke saath raha. Phir us ki maut ka waqt aaya to us ne mujhe Nasibin ke ek ibadat guzar ka pata bataya.

dialogue.ar: فَرَحَلْتُ إِلى رَجُلٍ مِنْ عَمّورِيَّةَ، وَأَقَمْتُ مَعَهُ، ثُمَّ حَضَرَتْهُ الوَفاةُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-raḥaltu ilā rajulin min ʿAmmūriyya, wa aqamtu maʿah, thumma ḥaḍarathu l-wafāh
dialogue.en: Then I travelled to a man from Ammuriyya and stayed with him, then death came to him.
dialogue.ur: Phir main Ammuriyya ke ek aadmi ke paas gaya, us ke saath raha, phir us ki maut ka waqt aaya.

dialogue.ar: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: إِلى مَنْ تُوصي بي؟ فَقالَ: يا بُنَيَّ ما أَعْرِفُ أَحَداً عَلى مِثْلِ ما كُنّا عَلَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-qultu lah: ilā man tūṣī bī? fa-qāl: yā bunayya mā aʿrifu aḥadan ʿalā mithli mā kunnā ʿalayh
dialogue.en: I said to him: To whom do you advise me to go? He said: My son, I know no one like what we were on.
dialogue.ur: Maine kaha: Aap mujhe kis ke paas jaane ko kehte hain? Us ne kaha: Beta, main kisi ko nahin jaanta jo us raaste par ho jis par hum the.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنْ هَذا زَمانُ نَبِيٍّ يُبْعَثُ بِدينِ إِبْراهيمَ حَنيفاً، يُهاجِرُ إِلى أَرْضٍ ذاتِ نَخْلٍ بَيْنَ حَرَّتَيْنِ، فَاذْهَبْ إِلَيْهِ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ.
dialogue.tr: wa lākin hādhā zamānu nabiyyin yubʿathu bi-dīni Ibrāhīma ḥanīfan, yuhājiru ilā arḍin dhāti nakhlin bayna ḥarratayn, fa-dhhab ilayhi ini staṭaʿt
dialogue.en: But this is the time of a prophet who will be sent with the religion of Ibrahim, upright. He will emigrate to a land of palm trees between two lava plains. Go to him if you can.
dialogue.ur: Lekin yeh us nabi ka zamana hai jo Ibrahim ke deen ke saath, yaksu hokar, bheja jayega. Woh do pathreeli zameenon ke darmiyan khajoor wali zameen ki taraf hijrat karega. Agar ho sake to us ke paas jao.

dialogue.ar: فَهُوَ لا يَأْكُلُ الصَّدَقَةَ، وَيَقْبَلُ الهَدِيَّةَ، وَإِنَّ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ خاتَمَ النُّبُوَّةِ، إِذا رَأَيْتَهُ عَرَفْتَهُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-huwa lā yaʾkulu ṣ-ṣadaqah, wa yaqbalu l-hadiyyah, wa inna bayna katifayhi khātama n-nubuwwah, idhā raʾaytahu ʿaraftah
dialogue.en: He does not eat charity, he accepts gifts, and between his shoulders is the seal of prophethood. When you see him, you will know him.
dialogue.ur: Woh sadqa nahin khata, tohfa qubool karta hai, aur us ke dono kandhon ke beech mohr-e-nubuwwat hai. Jab tum use dekhoge to pehchan loge.

dialogue.ar: فَمَرَّ بي رَكْبٌ، وَذَهَبْتُ مَعَهُمْ حَتّى وَصَلوا إِلى وادي القُرى فَظَلَموني وَباعوني إِلى رَجُلٍ مِنْ يَهودَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-marra bī rakb, wa dhahabtu maʿahum ḥattā waṣalū ilā Wādi l-Qurā fa-ẓalamūnī wa bāʿūnī ilā rajulin min Yahūd
dialogue.en: A caravan passed by me and I went with them until they reached Wadi al-Qura, where they wronged me and sold me to a Jewish man.
dialogue.ur: Ek qafila mere paas se guzra, main un ke saath chal para, yahan tak ke woh Wadi al-Qura pahunche. Unhon ne mujh par zulm kiya aur mujhe ek yahudi ke haath bech diya.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ خَرَجَ بي حَتّى قَدِمْتُ المَدينَةَ، فَوَاللهِ ما هُوَ إِلاّ أَنْ رَأَيْتُها حَتّى أَيْقَنْتُ أَنَّها البَلْدَةُ الَّتي وُصِفَتْ لي.
dialogue.tr: thumma kharaja bī ḥattā qadimtu l-Madīnah, fa-wallāhi mā huwa illā an raʾaytuhā ḥattā ayqantu annahā l-baldatu llatī wuṣifat lī
dialogue.en: Then he took me out until I reached Medina. By Allah, as soon as I saw it I was sure it was the town that had been described to me.
dialogue.ur: Phir woh mujhe le kar nikla yahan tak ke main Madina pahunch gaya. Allah ki qasam, jaise hi maine use dekha mujhe yaqeen ho gaya ke yahi woh shehar hai jis ka haal mujhe bataya gaya tha.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنِّي لَفي رَأْسِ نَخْلَةٍ يَوْماً، وَصاحِبي جالِسٌ تَحْتَها، إِذْ أَقْبَلَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ يَهودَ فَقالَ: قاتَلَ اللهُ بَني قَيْلَةَ، إِنَّهُمْ لَيَتَقاصَفونَ عَلى رَجُلٍ بِقُباءَ قادِمٍ مِنْ مَكَّةَ يَزْعُمونَ أَنَّهُ نَبِيٌّ.
dialogue.tr: wa innī la-fī raʾsi nakhlatin yawman, wa ṣāḥibī jālisun taḥtahā, idh aqbala rajulun min Yahūd fa-qāl: qātala llāhu Banī Qayla, innahum la-yataqāṣafūna ʿalā rajulin bi-Qubāʾ qādimin min Makkah yazʿumūna annahu nabiyy
dialogue.en: One day I was at the top of a palm tree and my master sat beneath it, when a Jewish man came and said: May Allah fight Banu Qayla, they are crowding around a man at Quba who came from Makkah and claim he is a prophet.
dialogue.ur: Ek din main khajoor ke darakht ki chotti par tha aur mera malik us ke neeche baitha tha ke ek yahudi aaya aur bola: Allah Banu Qayla ko tabah kare, woh Quba mein Makkah se aaye hue ek aadmi ke gird bheed lagaye hue hain jise woh nabi samajhte hain.

dialogue.ar: فَوَاللهِ ما هُوَ إِلاّ أَنْ قالَها حَتّى أَخَذَتْني رَعْشَةٌ، حَتّى كِدْتُ أَسْقُطُ فَوْقَ صاحِبي.
dialogue.tr: fa-wallāhi mā huwa illā an qālahā ḥattā akhadhatnī raʿshah, ḥattā kidtu asquṭu fawqa ṣāḥibī
dialogue.en: By Allah, as soon as he said it, a shiver took hold of me so that I almost fell on top of my master.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki qasam, jaise hi us ne yeh kaha mujh par kapkapi taari ho gayi, yahan tak ke main apne malik ke upar girne hi wala tha.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا أَمْسَيْتُ جَمَعْتُ ما كانَ عِنْدي، ثُمَّ خَرَجْتُ حَتّى جِئْتُ رَسولَ اللهِ ﷺ بِقُباءَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-lammā amsaytu jamaʿtu mā kāna ʿindī, thumma kharajtu ḥattā jiʾtu rasūla llāhi ﷺ bi-Qubāʾ
dialogue.en: In the evening I gathered what I had and went out until I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at Quba.
dialogue.ur: Shaam hui to maine jo kuch mere paas tha jama kiya, phir nikla yahan tak ke Quba mein Rasoolullah ﷺ ke paas pahunch gaya.

dialogue.ar: فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: إِنَّكُمْ أَهْلُ حاجَةٍ وَغُرْبَةٍ، وَقَدْ كانَ عِنْدي طَعامٌ نَذَرْتُهُ لِلصَّدَقَةِ، فَجِئْتُكُمْ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-qultu lah: innakum ahlu ḥājatin wa ghurbah, wa qad kāna ʿindī ṭaʿāmun nadhartuhu li-ṣ-ṣadaqah, fa-jiʾtukum bih
dialogue.en: I said to him: You are people in need and far from home. I had food I had vowed as charity, so I brought it to you.
dialogue.ur: Maine arz kiya: Aap log hajat mand aur pardesi hain. Mere paas kuch khana tha jo maine sadqe ke liye nazar maana tha, so woh aap ke paas le aaya.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ لِأَصْحابِهِ: كُلوا بِاسْمِ اللهِ، وَأَمْسَكَ هُوَ فَلَمْ يَبْسُطْ إِلَيْهِ يَدا.
dialogue.tr: fa-qāla r-rasūlu ﷺ li-aṣḥābihi: kulū bismi llāh, wa amsaka huwa fa-lam yabsuṭ ilayhi yadā
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said to his companions: Eat, in the name of Allah. He himself held back and did not stretch out his hand to it.
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne apne sahaba se farmaya: Allah ke naam se khao. Aur khud ruk gaye, us ki taraf haath nahin barhaya.

dialogue.ar: فَقُلْتُ في نَفْسي: هَذِهِ واللهِ واحِدَةٌ، إِنَّهُ لا يَأْكُلُ الصَّدَقَةَ!
dialogue.tr: fa-qultu fī nafsī: hādhihi wallāhi wāḥidah, innahu lā yaʾkulu ṣ-ṣadaqah!
dialogue.en: I said to myself: This, by Allah, is one sign. He does not eat charity!
dialogue.ur: Maine apne dil mein kaha: Allah ki qasam, yeh ek nishani hai. Woh sadqa nahin khate!

dialogue.ar: إِنِّي رَأَيْتُكَ لا تَأْكُلُ الصَّدَقَةَ، وَقَدْ كانَ عِنْدي شَيْءٌ أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُكْرِمَكَ بِهِ هَدِيَّةً، فَوَضَعْتُهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، فَقالَ لِأَصْحابِهِ: كُلوا بِاسْمِ اللهِ، وَأَكَلَ مَعَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: innī raʾaytuka lā taʾkulu ṣ-ṣadaqah, wa qad kāna ʿindī shayʾun uḥibbu an ukrimaka bihi hadiyyah, fa-waḍaʿtuhu bayna yadayh, fa-qāla li-aṣḥābih: kulū bismi llāh, wa akala maʿahum
dialogue.en: I saw that you do not eat charity, and I had something I wished to honour you with as a gift. I placed it before him; he told his companions: Eat in the name of Allah, and he ate with them.
dialogue.ur: Maine dekha ke aap sadqa nahin khate, mere paas kuch tha jo main aap ko tohfe ke taur par pesh karna chahta tha. Maine use un ke saamne rakh diya. Unhon ne sahaba se kaha: Allah ke naam se khao, aur khud bhi un ke saath khaya.

dialogue.ar: فَقُلْتُ لِنَفْسي: هَذِهِ واللهِ الثّانِيَةُ؛ إِنَّهُ يَأْكُلُ الهَدِيَّةَ!
dialogue.tr: fa-qultu li-nafsī: hādhihi wallāhi th-thāniyah; innahu yaʾkulu l-hadiyyah!
dialogue.en: I said to myself: This, by Allah, is the second sign; he eats a gift!
dialogue.ur: Maine dil mein kaha: Allah ki qasam, yeh doosri nishani hai; woh tohfa khate hain!

dialogue.ar: فَإِذا العَلامَةُ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ، خاتَمُ النُّبُوَّةِ، كَما وَصَفَهُ لي صاحِبي، فَأَكْبَبْتُ عَلَيْهِ أُقَبِّلُهُ وَأَبْكي.
dialogue.tr: fa-idhā l-ʿalāmatu bayna katifayh, khātamu n-nubuwwah, kamā waṣafahu lī ṣāḥibī, fa-akbabtu ʿalayhi uqabbiluhu wa abkī
dialogue.en: There was the mark between his shoulders, the seal of prophethood, just as my companion had described it to me. I threw myself on him, kissing it and weeping.
dialogue.ur: Dekha to dono kandhon ke beech wahi nishani thi, mohr-e-nubuwwat, jaisa mere sathi ne bataya tha. Main un par jhuk gaya, use choomta aur rota tha.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ دَعاني فَجَلَسْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، فَحَدَّثْتُهُ حَديثي كَما أُحَدِّثُكُمُ الآنَ، ثُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ.
dialogue.tr: thumma daʿānī fa-jalastu bayna yadayh, fa-ḥaddathtuhu ḥadīthī kamā uḥaddithukumu l-ān, thumma aslamt
dialogue.en: Then he called me, I sat before him, I told him my story as I am telling you now, and then I became a Muslim.
dialogue.ur: Phir unhon ne mujhe bulaya, main un ke saamne baith gaya, aur apni kahani un ko sunayi jaise abhi aap ko suna raha hoon, phir main musalman ho gaya.

vocab.ur: us ki maut ka waqt aa gaya

vocab.en: upright, turning to the one true God

q.en: What did Salman al-Farisi worship before Islam?
q.ur: Islam se pehle Salman al-Farisi kis ki ibadat karte the?
q.ar: ماذا كانَ سَلْمانُ الفارِسِيُّ يَعْبُدُ قَبْلَ الإِسْلامِ؟

q.en: Which town did the first Christians tell him to go to?
q.ur: Isayiyon ne pehle unhein kis jagah jaane ko kaha?
q.ar: إِلى أَيِّ بَلَدٍ طَلَبَ مِنْهُ أَوائِلُ النَّصارى أَنْ يَذْهَبَ؟

q.ur: «الصَّدَقَة» ka kya matlab hai?

options_ar: ما يُعْطيهِ المُسْلِمُ لِلْفَقيرِ طَلَباً لِلْأَجْرِ

q.en: Which was one of the signs of the Prophet ﷺ mentioned in the text?
q.ur: Matan mein Nabi ﷺ ki kaun si nishani bayan hui?
q.ar: ما العَلامَةُ الَّتي ذُكِرَتْ في النَّصِّ مِنْ عَلاماتِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ؟

q.ur: «خاتَمُ النُّبُوَّةِ» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: عَلامَةٌ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ تَدُلُّ عَلى نُبُوَّتِهِ

title.en: Grammar (A): The style of praise and blame
title.ur: Qawaid (A): Madh aur Zamm ka uslub

intro.en: To praise something Arabic uses «نِعْمَ» (what an excellent...), and to blame it uses «بِئْسَ» (what an evil...). After the verb comes the thing described, then the one being praised or blamed. Example: نِعْمَ العادِلُ عُمَرُ – Umar is an excellent just man. «حَبَّذا» also praises, and «لا حَبَّذا» blames.
intro.ur: Kisi cheez ki tareef ke liye «نِعْمَ» (kya hi achha...) aur burai ke liye «بِئْسَ» (kya hi bura...) istemal hota hai. Is ke baad woh cheez aati hai jis ki baat ho rahi hai, phir jis ki tareef ya burai ki jaye. Misal: نِعْمَ العادِلُ عُمَرُ – Umar kya hi achhe adil hain. «حَبَّذا» bhi tareef ke liye hai aur «لا حَبَّذا» burai ke liye.
intro.ar: لِلْمَدْحِ نَسْتَعْمِلُ «نِعْمَ» وَلِلذَّمِّ نَسْتَعْمِلُ «بِئْسَ». يَأْتي بَعْدَ الفِعْلِ الفاعِلُ ثُمَّ المَمْدوحُ أَوِ المَذْمومُ، مِثْلُ: نِعْمَ العادِلُ عُمَرُ. وَ«حَبَّذا» لِلْمَدْحِ أَيْضاً، وَ«لا حَبَّذا» لِلذَّمِّ.

intro.en: Two listening parts. First, the story of at-Tufayl ibn Amr ad-Dawsi, a poet whose people were Dawsis. When he came to Makkah the Quraysh warned him about the Prophet ﷺ, so he stuffed his ears with cotton. Second, Arabic proverbs, where a man called Shann looks for clever answers. Listen to the audio on the slides and answer true or false.
intro.ur: Do sunne wale hisse hain. Pehla: at-Tufayl bin Amr ad-Dawsi ka qissa, jo ek shayar the. Jab woh Makkah aaye to Quraish ne unhein Nabi ﷺ se daraya, to unhon ne apne kaanon mein rui thoons li. Doosra: Arabi misalein, jahan Shann naam ka aadmi hoshiyari ke jawab dhoondta hai. Slides ki audio sunein aur sahi ya ghalat batayein.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ: الأَوَّلُ قِصَّةُ الطُّفَيْلِ بْنِ عَمْروٍ الدَّوْسِيِّ حينَ قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ وَسَدَّ أُذُنَيْهِ بِالقُطْنِ خَوْفاً مِنْ سَماعِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ، وَالثّاني أَمْثالٌ عَرَبِيَّةٌ. اسْتَمِعْ إِلى الصَّوْتِ وَأَجِبْ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ.

intro.en: In this lesson you prepare a speech (khutba) on a topic you choose and practise delivering it to your classmates, without reading. You can write the main points, proofs and examples to prepare yourself. Tip: start with praise of Allah, state your topic clearly, give two or three examples, and finish with a short reminder.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein aap apni pasand ke mauzoo par taqreer (khutba) tayyar karte hain aur use sathiyon ke saamne bina parhe pesh karne ki mashq karte hain. Tayyari ke liye nukat, dalail aur misalein likh sakte hain. Mashwara: Allah ki hamd se shuru karein, mauzoo saaf bayan karein, do teen misalein dein aur chhoti si yaad-dehani par khatam karein.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ تَسْتَعِدُّ لِخُطْبَةٍ في مَوْضوعٍ تَخْتارُهُ، ثُمَّ تُلْقيها أَمامَ زُمَلائِكَ دونَ قِراءَةٍ. اكْتُبِ العَناصِرَ وَالأَدِلَّةَ وَالأَمْثِلَةَ لِتَسْتَعِدَّ. اِبْدَأْ بِحَمْدِ اللهِ، وَاذْكُرْ مَوْضوعَكَ بِوُضوحٍ، وَأَعْطِ مِثالَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاثَةً، ثُمَّ اخْتِمْ بِتَذْكيرٍ قَصيرٍ.

intro.en: The little word «ما» has many jobs. It can be a question word (what?), a relative word (that which: سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ – I heard what you said), a negative (ما هذا بَشَراً – this is not a human), a word that makes a verb into a noun (أَعْجَبَني ما فَعَلْتَ – what you did pleased me), a word acting like «لَيْسَ», or a stopper (كافَّة) after «إِنَّ»: إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ – knowledge is indeed light.
intro.ur: Chhota sa lafz «ما» kai kaam karta hai. Yeh sawal ka lafz ho sakta hai (kya?), mausool (jo kuch: سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ – maine suna jo tum ne kaha), nafi ka (ما هذا بَشَراً – yeh insaan nahin), fel ko masdar bana dene wala (أَعْجَبَني ما فَعَلْتَ – tumhara kaam mujhe pasand aaya), «لَيْسَ» ki tarah amal karne wala, ya «إِنَّ» ke baad rukawat dalne wala (كافَّة): إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ – ilm to roshni hi hai.
intro.ar: لِكَلِمَةِ «ما» اسْتِعْمالاتٌ كَثيرَةٌ: فَقَدْ تَكونُ اسْتِفْهامِيَّةً، أَوْ مَوْصولَةً مِثْلَ: سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ، أَوْ نافِيَةً مِثْلَ: ما هذا بَشَراً، أَوْ مَصْدَرِيَّةً مِثْلَ: أَعْجَبَني ما فَعَلْتَ، أَوْ تَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ «لَيْسَ»، أَوْ كافَّةً بَعْدَ «إِنَّ» مِثْلَ: إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ.

dialogue.ar: اتْرُكْ ما مَعَكَ.
dialogue.tr: utruk mā maʿak
dialogue.en: Leave what is with you. («ما» = that which, relative)
dialogue.ur: Jo tumhare paas hai use chhor do. («ما» = jo, mausool)

dialogue.ar: رَأَيْتُ ما بِيَدِكَ.
dialogue.tr: raʾaytu mā bi-yadik
dialogue.en: I saw what is in your hand.
dialogue.ur: Maine woh dekha jo tumhare haath mein hai.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ.
dialogue.tr: samiʿtu mā qultah
dialogue.en: I heard what you said.
dialogue.ur: Maine woh suna jo tum ne kaha.

dialogue.ar: ما عِنْدَكَ مِنْ مالٍ يَنْفَدُ.
dialogue.tr: mā ʿindaka min mālin yanfad
dialogue.en: The wealth you have runs out.
dialogue.ur: Tumhare paas jo maal hai woh khatam ho jata hai.

dialogue.ar: أَعْجَبَني ما فَعَلْتَ.
dialogue.tr: aʿjabanī mā faʿalt
dialogue.en: What you did pleased me. («ما» + verb = a noun meaning)
dialogue.ur: Tumhara kaam mujhe pasand aaya. («ما» + fel = masdar ke maani)

dialogue.ar: ما إِدْراكُ العُلا سَهْلاً.
dialogue.tr: mā idrāku l-ʿulā sahlan
dialogue.en: Reaching high honour is not easy. («ما» acts like «لَيْسَ»)
dialogue.ur: Buland maqam paana aasan nahin. («ما» «لَيْسَ» ki tarah)

dialogue.ar: ما التَّنافُسُ مَذْموماً.
dialogue.tr: mā t-tanāfusu madhmūman
dialogue.en: Competition is not blameworthy.
dialogue.ur: Muqabla bura nahin hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ.
dialogue.tr: innamā l-ʿilmu nūr
dialogue.en: Knowledge is indeed a light. («ما» stops «إِنَّ» from working)
dialogue.ur: Ilm to roshni hi hai. («ما» «إِنَّ» ka amal rok deta hai)

dialogue.ar: اِعْلَمْ أَنَّما اللهُ واحِدٌ.
dialogue.tr: iʿlam annamā llāhu wāḥid
dialogue.en: Know that Allah is only One.
dialogue.ur: Jaan lo ke Allah sirf ek hai.

dialogue.ar: كَأَنَّما وَجْهُها قَمَرٌ.
dialogue.tr: ka-annamā wajhuhā qamar
dialogue.en: As if her face were a moon.
dialogue.ur: Goya us ka chehra chaand hai.

vocab.en: «ما» that stops the previous word's effect

q.en: In «سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ», what kind of «ما» is it?
q.ur: «سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ» mein «ما» kaun sa hai?
q.ar: في جُمْلَةِ «سَمِعْتُ ما قُلْتَهُ» ما نَوْعُ «ما»؟

q.ur: «إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: A story about a village judge who settles disputes after Friday prayer. A neighbour complains about a stranger, but the judge listens carefully and teaches everyone about the rights of neighbours. As you read, notice the judge's calm questions and how each side explains.
intro.ur: Ek gaon ke qazi ki kahani jo Jumma ki namaz ke baad jhagde nipatata hai. Ek padosi ek ajnabi ki shikayat karta hai, lekin qazi dhyan se sunta hai aur sab ko padosiyon ke huqooq sikhata hai. Parhte hue qazi ke pur-sukoon sawalat aur har taraf ke jawab par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ عَنْ قاضٍ في قَرْيَةٍ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَ الخُصومِ بَعْدَ صَلاةِ الجُمُعَةِ. يَشْكو جارٌ مِنْ غَريبٍ، وَيَسْتَمِعُ القاضي بِعِنايَةٍ، ثُمَّ يُعَلِّمُ النّاسَ حُقوقَ الجيرانِ. لاحِظْ أَسْئِلَةَ القاضي الهادِئَةَ وَكَيْفَ يَشْرَحُ كُلُّ طَرَفٍ حُجَّتَهُ.

dialogue.ar: اِعْتادَ أَهْلُ قَرْيَةٍ أَنْ يَجْتَمِعوا في ساحَةِ القَرْيَةِ بَعْدَ صَلاةِ الجُمُعَةِ، فَإِنْ كانَ لِأَحَدٍ عِنْدَ أَحَدٍ مَظْلَمَةٌ حَكَّموا بَيْنَهُما رَجُلاً سَمَّوهُ بِاسْمِ «قاضي الجيرانِ».
dialogue.tr: iʿtāda ahlu qaryatin an yajtamiʿū fī sāḥati l-qaryati baʿda ṣalāti l-jumuʿa, fa-in kāna li-aḥadin ʿinda aḥadin maẓlamatun ḥakkamū baynahumā rajulan sammawhu bi-ismi «qāḍī l-jīrān»
dialogue.en: The people of a village were used to gathering in the village square after Friday prayer. If someone had a complaint against another, they made a man judge between them whom they named the Neighbours' Judge.
dialogue.ur: Ek gaon walon ki aadat thi ke Jumma ki namaz ke baad gaon ke maidan mein jama hote. Agar kisi ka kisi par haq ho ya zulm ka shikwa ho to woh un ke darmiyan ek aadmi ko faisla karne ke liye muqarrar karte jise woh «Padosiyon ka Qazi» kehte.

dialogue.ar: فَكُلُّ واحِدٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ القَرْيَةِ عَرَفَ ما لَهُ وَما عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الحُقوقِ وَالواجِباتِ، وَأَدْرَكَ أَنَّ السَّعادَةَ وَالسَّلامَةَ مُرْتَبِطَتانِ بِالوُقوفِ عِنْدَ الحَقِّ وَالالْتِزامِ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-kullu wāḥidin min ahli l-qaryati ʿarafa mā lahu wa mā ʿalayhi mina l-ḥuqūqi wa l-wājibāt, wa adraka anna s-saʿādata wa s-salāmata murtabiṭatāni bi-l-wuqūfi ʿinda l-ḥaqqi wa l-iltizāmi bih
dialogue.en: Each person in the village knew his rights and duties, and realised that happiness and safety are tied to standing by the truth and keeping to it.
dialogue.ur: Gaon ka har shakhs apne huqooq aur farayiz jaanta tha aur samajhta tha ke khushi aur salamati haq par qayam rehne aur us ki pabandi se jurri hui hain.

dialogue.ar: وَظَلّوا عَلى تِلْكَ الحالِ حَتّى سَكَنَ في قَرْيَتِهِمْ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ أُخْرى، فَكَثُرَتْ ضِدَّهُ الشَّكاوى، وَثارَ الجيرانُ مِنْ مُعامَلَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ẓallū ʿalā tilka l-ḥāl ḥattā sakana fī qaryatihim rajulun min qaryatin ukhrā, fa-kathurat ḍiddahu sh-shakāwā, wa thāra l-jīrānu min muʿāmalatih
dialogue.en: They stayed like that until a man from another village settled among them. Complaints against him grew many, and the neighbours were angered by how he treated them.
dialogue.ur: Woh isi haal par rahe yahan tak ke un ke gaon mein doosre gaon ka ek aadmi aa baisa. Us ke khilaf shikayatein bahut barh gayin aur padosi us ke bartao se bhar uthe.

dialogue.ar: فَوَجَدَ القاضي أَكْثَرَ مِنْ شَكْوى ضِدَّ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلِ. فَقالَ مُخاطِباً نَفْسَهُ: لَعَلَّ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلَ قَتَلَ الأَبْرِياءَ، وَسَرَقَ الأَمْوالَ، وَاعْتَدى عَلى الأَعْراضِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-wajada l-qāḍī akthara min shakwā ḍidda dhālika r-rajul. fa-qāla mukhāṭiban nafsah: laʿalla dhālika r-rajula qatala l-abriyāʾ, wa saraqa l-amwāl, wa ʿtadā ʿala l-aʿrāḍ
dialogue.en: The judge found more than one complaint against that man and said to himself: Perhaps that man killed innocents, stole money, and attacked people's honour.
dialogue.ur: Qazi ne us aadmi ke khilaf ek se zyada shikayatein paayin aur apne aap se kaha: Shayad us ne begunahon ko qatl kiya, maal churaya aur izzaton par hamla kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلى كُلِّ حالٍ لا أَسْتَطيعُ أَنْ أَنْطِقَ بِالحُكْمِ، ما لَمْ أَسْتَمِعْ مِنَ المُتَخاصِمينَ جَميعاً.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalā kulli ḥālin lā astaṭīʿu an anṭiqa bi-l-ḥukm, mā lam astamiʿ mina l-mutakhāṣimīna jamīʿā
dialogue.en: In any case, I cannot pronounce a judgment unless I listen to all the disputing parties.
dialogue.ur: Bahar haal main faisla nahin sunata jab tak jhagadne walon sab ki baat na sun loon.

dialogue.ar: أَيُّها القاضي المُحْتَرَمُ، إِنَّ هَذا الجارَ لا يَعْرِفُ لي حَقّاً! دُهِشَ الرَّجُلُ الغَريبُ؛ فَهُوَ لا يَذْكُرُ أَنَّهُ اعْتَدى عَلَيْهِ، أَوْ أَكَلَ مالَهُ!
dialogue.tr: ayyuhā l-qāḍī l-muḥtaram, inna hādhā l-jāra lā yaʿrifu lī ḥaqqā! duhisha r-rajulu l-gharīb; fa-huwa lā yadhkuru annahu ʿtadā ʿalayh, aw akala mālah
dialogue.en: Respected judge, this neighbour does not recognise any right of mine! The stranger was astonished; he does not recall attacking him or eating his property!
dialogue.ur: Muhtaram qazi sahab, yeh padosi mera koi haq nahin pehchanta! Ajnabi hairan reh gaya; use yaad nahin ke us ne is par zyadti ki ho ya is ka maal khaya ho!

dialogue.ar: وَماذا فَعَلَ؟
dialogue.tr: wa mādhā faʿal?
dialogue.en: And what did he do?
dialogue.ur: Aur us ne kya kiya?

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ طَلَبْتُ مِنْهُ أَنْ يُعينَني عَلى رَفْعِ كيسٍ مِنَ القَمْحِ، فَنَظَرَ إِلَيَّ بِاسْتِغْرابٍ، وَدَخَلَ بَيْتَهُ.
dialogue.tr: laqad ṭalabtu minhu an yuʿīnanī ʿalā rafʿi kīsin mina l-qamḥ, fa-naẓara ilayya bi-stighrāb, wa dakhala baytah
dialogue.en: I asked him to help me lift a sack of wheat; he looked at me with surprise and went into his house.
dialogue.ur: Maine us se kaha ke gandum ka bora uthane mein meri madad kare, to us ne hairat se mujhe dekha aur apne ghar mein chala gaya.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ واحِدَةٌ، وَماذا أَيْضاً؟
dialogue.tr: hādhihi wāḥida, wa mādhā ayḍan?
dialogue.en: That is one. And what else?
dialogue.ur: Yeh ek hui. Aur kya?

dialogue.ar: وَطَلَبْتُ مِنْهُ أَنْ يُقْرِضَني مَبْلَغاً مِنَ المالِ فَرَفَضَ.
dialogue.tr: wa ṭalabtu minhu an yuqriḍanī mablaghan mina l-māl fa-rafaḍ
dialogue.en: And I asked him to lend me a sum of money and he refused.
dialogue.ur: Aur maine us se kuch raqam qarz maangi to us ne inkar kar diya.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا أَيْضاً؟ اُذْكُرْ كُلَّ ما لَدَيْكَ.
dialogue.tr: wa mādhā ayḍan? udhkur kulla mā ladayk
dialogue.en: And what else? Mention everything you have.
dialogue.ur: Aur kya? Jo kuch tumhare paas hai sab bayan karo.

dialogue.ar: وَمَرِضْتُ أُسْبوعاً، فَلَمْ يَأْتِ لِزِيارَتي، وَنَجَحَ ابني، فَلَمْ يُشارِكْني في فَرْحَتي، وَتُوُفِّيَ والِدي فَلَمْ يَطْرُقْ بابَ مَنْزِلي، لِيُعَزِّيَني وَيُخَفِّفَ عَنّي، وَلَمْ يَخْرُجْ مَعَنا إِلى المَقْبَرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa mariḍtu usbūʿan, fa-lam yaʾti li-ziyāratī, wa najaḥa ibnī, fa-lam yushārik-nī fī farḥatī, wa tuwuffiya wālidī fa-lam yaṭruq bāba manzilī, li-yuʿazziyanī wa yukhaffifa ʿannī, wa lam yakhruj maʿanā ilā l-maqbara
dialogue.en: I was ill for a week and he did not visit me; my son succeeded and he did not share my joy; my father died and he did not knock on my door to console me and ease my grief, nor did he go out with us to the graveyard.
dialogue.ur: Main ek hafta beemar raha to woh mujhe dekhne nahin aaya; mera beta kamyab hua to woh meri khushi mein shareek nahin hua; mere walid faut hue to us ne mere ghar ka darwaza nahin khatkhataya ke taziyat kare aur gham halka kare, aur woh hamare saath qabristan bhi nahin gaya.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ لَدَيْكَ شَيْءٌ آخَرُ؟
dialogue.tr: hal ladayka shayʾun ākhar?
dialogue.en: Do you have anything else?
dialogue.ur: Kya tumhare paas kuch aur hai?

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ لَدَيَّ شَيْءٌ آخَرُ أَقولُهُ، وَلا أُريدُ أَنْ أَتَّهِمَهُ بِما لَمْ يَفْعَلْ.
dialogue.tr: laysa ladayya shayʾun ākharu aqūluh, wa lā urīdu an attahimahu bi-mā lam yafʿal
dialogue.en: I have nothing else to say, and I do not want to accuse him of what he did not do.
dialogue.ur: Mere paas kehne ko aur kuch nahin, aur main nahin chahta ke us par woh ilzam lagaun jo us ne kiya hi nahin.

dialogue.ar: بارَكَ اللهُ فيكَ، فَإِنَّ اتِّهامَ النّاسِ بِما لَمْ يَفْعَلوهُ يوجِبُ غَضَبَ اللهِ تَعالى.
dialogue.tr: bāraka llāhu fīk, fa-inna ttihāma n-nāsi bi-mā lam yafʿalūhu yūjibu ghaḍaba llāhi taʿālā
dialogue.en: May Allah bless you, for accusing people of what they did not do brings the anger of Allah, the Most High.
dialogue.ur: Allah tumhein barkat de, kyunke logon par woh ilzam lagana jo unhon ne kiya hi nahin Allah taala ke ghusse ka sabab banta hai.

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ أَيُّها القاضي، وَلَكِنَّني لَمْ أَعْتَدِ عَلَيْهِ وَلَمْ أَضْرِبْهُ، وَلَمْ أَدْخُلْ بَيْتَهُ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ، وَلَمْ أَقْطَعْ غُصْناً مِنْ أَشْجارِ بُسْتانِهِ، وَلَمْ أَقْتَرِضْ مِنْهُ مالاً. فَكَيْفَ يَقولُ إِنَّني لا أَعْرِفُ حَقَّهُ؟!
dialogue.tr: naʿam ayyuhā l-qāḍī, wa lākinnanī lam aʿtadi ʿalayh wa lam aḍribh, wa lam adkhul baytahu bi-ghayri idhnih, wa lam aqṭaʿ ghuṣnan min ashjāri bustānih, wa lam aqtariḍ minhu mālā. fa-kayfa yaqūlu innanī lā aʿrifu ḥaqqah?!
dialogue.en: Yes, judge, but I did not attack him, nor hit him, nor enter his house without permission, nor cut a branch from the trees of his orchard, nor borrow money from him. So how can he say I do not know his right?!
dialogue.ur: Ji qazi sahab, lekin maine na us par zyadti ki, na use mara, na us ke ghar bina ijazat gaya, na us ke bagh ke darakht ki daali kaati, na us se qarz liya. Phir woh kaise kehta hai ke main us ka haq nahin pehchanta?!

dialogue.ar: كُلُّ ما ذَكَرْتَهُ طَيِّبٌ وَحَسَنٌ، وَلَكِنْ لا يَكْفي عَدَمُ الاعْتِداءِ عَلى الجيرانِ، حَتّى يُعَدَّ ذَلِكَ إِحْساناً إِلَيْهِمْ. فَرُبَّما كانوا مُحْتاجينَ لِمَعونَةٍ أَوْ لِمالٍ، وَعِنْدَما تَمْتَنِعُ عَنْ إِعانَتِهِمْ وَإِقْراضِهِمْ، تَكونُ قَدْ أَعَنْتَ المَصائِبَ وَالفَقْرَ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَهَلْ تَرْضى بِذَلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: kullu mā dhakartahu ṭayyibun wa ḥasan, wa lākin lā yakfī ʿadamu l-iʿtidāʾi ʿala l-jīrān, ḥattā yuʿadda dhālika iḥsānan ilayhim. fa-rubbamā kānū muḥtājīna li-maʿūnatin aw li-māl, wa ʿindamā tamtaniʿu ʿan iʿānatihim wa iqrāḍihim, takūnu qad aʿanta l-maṣāʾiba wa l-faqra ʿalayhim, fa-hal tarḍā bi-dhālik?
dialogue.en: All you mentioned is good, but not harming neighbours is not enough to count as kindness to them. Perhaps they needed help or money, and when you refuse to help or lend, you help misfortune and poverty against them. Are you content with that?
dialogue.ur: Jo kuch tum ne bataya sab achha hai, lekin sirf padosiyon par zyadti na karna kaafi nahin ke use un ke saath ehsan kaha jaye. Ho sakta hai woh madad ya maal ke mohtaj hon, aur jab tum un ki madad ya qarz se ruk jaate ho to tum museebaton aur ghurbat ko un par ghalib karne mein madad karte ho. Kya tum is se razi ho?

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ طَلَبَ القاضي مِنْ رَجُلٍ آخَرَ أَنْ يَتَقَدَّمَ، لِيَسْتَمِعَ إِلى شَكْواهُ، فَتَقَدَّمَ رَجُلٌ كَبيرُ السِّنِّ.
dialogue.tr: thumma ṭalaba l-qāḍī min rajulin ākhara an yataqaddam, li-yastamiʿa ilā shakwāh, fa-taqaddama rajulun kabīru s-sinn
dialogue.en: Then the judge asked another man to step forward to hear his complaint, and an elderly man came forward.
dialogue.ur: Phir qazi ne ek aur aadmi ko aage aane ko kaha taake us ki shikayat sune, to ek buzurg aadmi aage aaya.

dialogue.ar: أَيُّها القاضي: أَنْصِفْني مِنْ هَذا الجارِ، إِنَّهُ يُؤْذيني في اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهارِ، لَقَدْ نَغَّصَ عَلَيَّ حَياتي، وَحَرَّضَ عَلَيَّ أَبْنائي، وَكادَ يُفْقِدُني سَعادَتي في مَنْزِلي.
dialogue.tr: ayyuhā l-qāḍī: anṣifnī min hādhā l-jār, innahu yuʾdhīnī fi l-layli wa n-nahār, laqad naghghaṣa ʿalayya ḥayātī, wa ḥarraḍa ʿalayya abnāʾī, wa kāda yufqidunī saʿādatī fī manzilī
dialogue.en: O judge, give me justice against this neighbour. He harms me night and day, he has spoiled my life, set my sons against me, and nearly cost me my happiness in my home.
dialogue.ur: Qazi sahab, is padosi se mera insaaf karein. Woh raat din mujhe takleef deta hai, meri zindagi tang kar di, mere beton ko mere khilaf bhadkaya aur mere ghar ki khushi mujh se chheenne wala hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ هَذا الكَلامُ صَحيحٌ؟
dialogue.tr: hal hādhā l-kalāmu ṣaḥīḥ?
dialogue.en: Is this speech true?
dialogue.ur: Kya yeh baat sahi hai?

dialogue.ar: أَيُّها القاضي، إِنَّني لا أَذْكُرُ شَيْئاً مِمّا يَقولُهُ هَذا الرَّجُلُ، فَهَلْ لَدَيْهِ دَليلٌ؟
dialogue.tr: ayyuhā l-qāḍī, innanī lā adhkuru shayʾan mimmā yaqūluhu hādhā r-rajul, fa-hal ladayhi dalīl?
dialogue.en: Judge, I remember nothing of what this man says. Does he have any proof?
dialogue.ur: Qazi sahab, jo kuch yeh aadmi kehta hai mujhe us mein se kuch yaad nahin. Kya us ke paas koi saboot hai?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ لَدَيْكَ دَليلٌ أَيُّها الرَّجُلُ؟
dialogue.tr: hal ladayka dalīlun ayyuhā r-rajul?
dialogue.en: Do you have proof, man?
dialogue.ur: Kya tumhare paas saboot hai, bhai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، أَيُّها القاضي؛ إِنَّ هَذا الرَّجُلَ يَمْنَعُ عَنّي الشَّمْسَ وَالهَواءَ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, ayyuhā l-qāḍī; inna hādhā r-rajula yamnaʿu ʿannī sh-shamsa wa l-hawāʾ
dialogue.en: Yes, judge; this man keeps the sun and the air from me.
dialogue.ur: Ji qazi sahab, yeh aadmi mujh se dhoop aur hawa rok deta hai.

dialogue.ar: هاتِ دَليلَكَ.
dialogue.tr: hāti dalīlak
dialogue.en: Bring your proof.
dialogue.ur: Apna saboot pesh karo.

dialogue.ar: مَنْ مالِكُ الشَّمْسِ وَالهَواءِ؟
dialogue.tr: man mālikun ash-shamsi wa l-hawāʾ?
dialogue.en: Who is the owner of the sun and the air?
dialogue.ur: Dhoop aur hawa ka malik kaun hai?

dialogue.ar: اللهُ رَبُّ العالَمينَ، خالِقُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ.
dialogue.tr: Allāhu rabbu l-ʿālamīn, khāliqu kulli shayʾ
dialogue.en: Allah, Lord of the worlds, creator of everything.
dialogue.ur: Allah, rabb-ul-aalameen, har cheez ka khaliq.

dialogue.ar: فَكَيْفَ إِذَنْ يَمْنَعُني هَذا الرَّجُلُ مِنْهُما؟!!
dialogue.tr: fa-kayfa idhan yamnaʿunī hādhā r-rajulu minhumā?!!
dialogue.en: Then how can this man keep me from them?!!
dialogue.ur: Phir yeh aadmi mujhe in se kaise rok sakta hai?!!

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ رَفَعَ بِناءَهُ، وَأَعْلى جُدْرانَهُ دونَ أَنْ يَطْلُبَ مِنّي إِذْناً بِذَلِكَ. وَقَدْ مَنَعَ عَنْ داري المُتَواضِعَةِ ضَوْءَ الشَّمْسِ، وَحَجَبَ عَنّي الهَواءَ العَليلَ.
dialogue.tr: laqad rafaʿa bināʾah, wa aʿlā judrānah dūna an yaṭluba minnī idhnan bi-dhālik. wa qad manaʿa ʿan dārī l-mutawāḍiʿati ḍawʾa sh-shams, wa ḥajaba ʿannī l-hawāʾa l-ʿalīl
dialogue.en: He raised his building and made his walls higher without asking my permission. He has blocked the sunlight from my humble house and shut the fresh breeze from me.
dialogue.ur: Us ne apni imarat unchi ki aur deewarein bulandkin bina meri ijazat ke. Us ne mere sadah ghar se dhoop ki roshni rok di aur taazi hawa mujh se chhupa di.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ ماذا أَيُّها الرَّجُلُ العَجوزُ؟
dialogue.tr: thumma mādhā ayyuhā r-rajulu l-ʿajūz?
dialogue.en: Then what, old man?
dialogue.ur: Phir kya, baba ji?

dialogue.ar: إِنَّهُ يُؤْذيني، وَيُشْعِرُني بِفَقْري وَاحْتِياجي.
dialogue.tr: innahu yuʾdhīnī, wa yushʿirunī bi-faqrī wa ḥtiyājī
dialogue.en: He hurts me and makes me feel my poverty and need.
dialogue.ur: Woh mujhe takleef deta hai aur mujhe meri ghurbat aur mohtaji ka ehsas dilata hai.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ هَذا؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa hādhā?
dialogue.en: How is this?
dialogue.ur: Woh kaise?

dialogue.ar: إِنَّهُ يُطْعِمُ الطَّعامَ، وَيَشْوي اللَّحْمَ، فَتَنْتَشِرُ رائِحَةُ الشِّواءِ، وَتَنْطَلِقُ رَوائِحُ الطَّعامِ، مِمّا يَجْعَلُنا نَشْتَهي، وَنَزْهَدُ فيما في أَيْدينا مِنْ طَعامٍ قَليلٍ. وَجاري لا يَتَذَكَّرُ أَنَّنا أَيْضاً بَشَرٌ مِثْلُهُ، لا يُفَكِّرُ ولَوْ مَرَّةً واحِدَةً أَنْ يَبْعَثَ لَنا شَيْئاً مِمّا طَبَخَ.
dialogue.tr: innahu yuṭʿimu ṭ-ṭaʿām, wa yashwī l-laḥm, fa-tantashiru rāʾiḥatu sh-shiwāʾ, wa tanṭaliqu rawāʾiḥu ṭ-ṭaʿām, mimmā yajʿalunā nashtahī, wa nazhadu fīmā fī aydīnā min ṭaʿāmin qalīl. wa jārī lā yatadhakkaru annanā aydan basharun mithluh, lā yufakkiru walaw marratan wāḥidah an yabʿatha lanā shayʾan mimmā ṭabakh
dialogue.en: He feeds food and grills meat, the smell of the roast spreads and the aromas of cooking rise, making us crave it and look down on the little food we have. My neighbour forgets we are people like him; he does not think, even once, of sending us something of what he cooked.
dialogue.ur: Woh khana khilata hai aur gosht bhoonta hai, bhoone hue gosht ki khushboo phailti hai aur khane ki mahak uthti hai, jis se hamara dil chahne lagta hai aur jo thora sa khana hamare paas hai us se dil hat jata hai. Mera padosi yaad nahin rakhta ke hum bhi us jaise insaan hain, woh ek baar bhi nahin sochta ke jo pakaya us mein se kuch hamein bhej de.

dialogue.ar: نَظَرَ الحاضِرونَ إِلى وَجْهِ الرَّجُلِ الغَريبِ، وَقَدِ احْمَرَّ خَجَلاً، وَنَظَروا إِلى عَيْنَيِ الشَّيْخِ، وَقَدْ مَلَأَتْهُما الدُّموعُ.
dialogue.tr: naẓara l-ḥāḍirūna ilā wajhi r-rajuli l-gharīb, wa qadi ḥmarra khajalan, wa naẓarū ilā ʿaynayi sh-shaykh, wa qad malaʾathumā d-dumūʿ
dialogue.en: Those present looked at the stranger's face, red with shame, and at the elder's eyes, filled with tears.
dialogue.ur: Hazireen ne ajnabi ke chehre ki taraf dekha jo sharm se surkh ho gaya tha, aur buzurg ki aankhon ko dekha jo aansuon se bhar gayin.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ ما قالَهُ الجيرانُ صَحيحٌ؟
dialogue.tr: hal mā qālahu l-jīrānu ṣaḥīḥ?
dialogue.en: Is what the neighbours said true?
dialogue.ur: Kya jo padosiyon ne kaha woh sahi hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، وَإِنِّي أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ مِمّا فَعَلْتُ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, wa innī astaghfiru llāha mimmā faʿalt
dialogue.en: Yes, and I ask Allah's forgiveness for what I did.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, aur jo kuch maine kiya us par main Allah se maafi chahta hoon.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ لِجيرانِكَ عَلَيْكَ حُقوقاً كَثيرَةً بَيَّنَتْها الشَّريعَةُ. وَكانَ رَسولُنا الكَريمُ ﷺ يوصينا بِالجارِ دائِماً، فَما بالُكَ لا تَفي بِحُقوقِ الجيرانِ؟
dialogue.tr: inna li-jīrānika ʿalayka ḥuqūqan kathīra bayyanathā sh-sharīʿa. wa kāna rasūlunā l-karīmu ﷺ yūṣīnā bi-l-jāri dāʾimā, fa-mā bāluka lā tafī bi-ḥuqūqi l-jīrān?
dialogue.en: Your neighbours have many rights over you which the Shariah has explained. Our noble Messenger ﷺ always advised us about the neighbour, so why do you not fulfil the neighbours' rights?
dialogue.ur: Tum par tumhare padosiyon ke bahut se huqooq hain jo shariat ne bayan kiye hain. Hamare karim Rasool ﷺ hamein hamesha padosi ke bare mein wasiyat karte the, phir tumhein kya hua ke padosiyon ke huqooq poore nahin karte?

vocab.ur: us ne faisla karne wala banaya
us ne rok diya, chhupa diya

q.en: When did the villagers gather in the square?
q.ur: Gaon wale maidan mein kab jama hote the?
q.ar: مَتى اجْتَمَعَ أَهْلُ القَرْيَةِ في السّاحَةِ؟

q.en: What did the first complainant ask the stranger to help him with?
q.ur: Pehle shikayat karne wale ne ajnabi se kis kaam mein madad maangi?
q.ar: بِماذا طَلَبَ الشّاكي الأَوَّلُ مِنَ الغَريبِ أَنْ يُساعِدَهُ؟

q.en: What did the elderly man say the neighbour blocked from his house?
q.ur: Buzurg ne kaha ke padosi ne us ke ghar se kya rok diya?
q.ar: ماذا قالَ الرَّجُلُ المُسِنُّ إِنَّ جارَهُ مَنَعَهُ عَنْ بَيْتِهِ؟

q.ur: «الجار» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: الَّذي لا تَعْرِفُهُ وَجاءَ مِنْ بَعيدٍ

q.en: What did the stranger say at the end?
q.ur: Aakhir mein ajnabi ne kya kaha?

options: He asked Allah's forgiveness for what he did
options_ar: طَلَبَ مِنَ اللهِ المَغْفِرَةَ عَلى ما فَعَلَ
